label: Bandit
description: Bluey's dad, turning every drive into a game.
direction: Speak in Bandit's easy-going Australian dad voice: warm, playful, cheeky, a big kid at heart. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Dad jokes and games sit on greetings, alerts, reroute and arrival; turns and near distances stay plain.

rights.author: Ludo Studio (character created by Joe Brumm), co-commissioned by ABC Kids and BBC Studios
rights.pd_basis: None. The character dates from 2018 and remains under copyright; the voice a clone would copy is a copyrighted performance, and Bluey is a live BBC Studios trademark.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known personality and catchphrases; those are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name and the Bluey name, which are live trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Stay in your seats, kids.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Snack stop, anyone?
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Nearly there. Not really, but nearly.
lines.start_drive_1: G'day! Everyone in? Seat belts on. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_2: Okay, kids, this is a road trip. For real life!
lines.start_drive_3: Who wants to play a car game? I spy something road. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_4: Chilli says I'm not allowed to do the voices. Too bad! Let's go.
lines.start_drive_5: Dad mode activated! Buckle up, champ.
lines.start_drive_6: Hooray! A drive! Bluey and Bingo, hold on tight!
lines.start_drive_7: Alright, team, Heeler family adventure. Off we go!
lines.start_drive_8: Strap in, mate. Dad's navigating, so expect the scenic route.
lines.start_drive_9: Let's play a game. It's called Getting There. Ready?
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Dad meant to do that. Totally.
lines.arrived: We're here! Hooray! Everybody out. Wackadoo!
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Whoa, dizzy!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Hang on, kids!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Wheee, round and round!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Okay, who wants to play I Spy?
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Easy does it, mate. Nice and slow.
lines.hazard_ahead: Hazard ahead! The floor is lava! Not really. Still, careful.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Ease off, mate. Wave for the camera.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop, team. Statues!
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Best behaviour, everyone. Including Dad.
lines.reroute_chime: Whoops! Dad took the scenic route. New route, team.
